title: Renaming inherited scenes with an AnimationPlayer child modify external .tres animations unprompted
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`, `4.8.dev7.official.c971f93e7`, `4.7.2.stable.fedora.ed1daf0bf`

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (nvidia; 615.71.09) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 30.71 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I broke animations in one of my projects in a very roundabout way. If `deterministic` is checked for AnimationTree, and there are animation libraries trying to use both `%GeneralSkeleton:LeftLowerArm` and `Armature/GeneralSkeleton:LeftLowerArm`, the unique one with `%` ends up fully overwriting the blended pose. I don't think that part is a bug but how I got to have a non-unique (`%`) bone reference in my animations is the bug.

It looks like having an `AnimationPlayer` child on a Node, and then renaming that (parent) Node modifies animations saved to `.tres` files external to the scene. It ends up breaking all other scenes that reference the same animations.

I have pushed up a repo at https://github.com/thayol/godot-anim-unique-revoke-bug with the short repro steps and a branch that shows the post-repro state.

### Steps to reproduce

1. `git clone https://github.com/thayol/godot-anim-unique-revoke-bug.git`
2. Open `project.godot` in Godot
3. Open `main.tscn` as the open scene
4. Rename (F2) `test_body` to `buggy_body`
5. Save the scene (Ctrl + S)
6. Confirm that `RESET.tres` and `bend.tres` have unstaged changes (`git status` reveals for example an unwanted `%GeneralSkeleton:Spine` to `Armature/GeneralSkeleton:Spine` change `RESET.tres`)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Repo: https://github.com/thayol/godot-anim-unique-revoke-bug
ZIP: [godot-anim-unique-revoke-bug-master.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33288537/godot-anim-unique-revoke-bug-master.zip)
